description: Class representing a collection of form roles.

params.description: The name of role being added.
params.name: name

GetCount.description: Returns a number of form roles.

GetRoleColor.description: Returns the RGB color of the specified role.

HaveRole.description: Checks if a role with the specified name exists.

MoveDown.description: Moves a role down in filling order.

MoveUp.description: Moves a role up in filling order.

Remove.description: Removes a role with the specified name.

params.description: The name of role to be removed.
params.name: name

params.description: The name of the role to which all forms bound to this role will be delegated.
params.name: delegateRole

SetRoleColor.description: Sets the color for the specified role.
